SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF FEB-27-2020 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF FEB-27-2020 BY A. JAMES ROBERTSON II. PLAINTIFF FULLER'S PAINTING REPRESENTED BY RAY FULLER, OWNER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT EMMANUEL OBEL IS PRESENT. MARCUS BOYDEN, TESTIFIES ON BEHALF OF DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED IN RELATED CASE OF CSM-20-862496 EMMANUEL OBEL VS. RAY CHARLES FULLER. JUDGE A. JAMES ROBERTSON II; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-27-2020 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FULLER'S PAINTING (RAY C. FULLER) IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT OBEL, EMMANUEL PLAINTIFF CLAIMS DEFENDANT OWES $5,000. THIS CLAIM IS RELATED TO THE CONTRACT CLAIM BY DEFENDANT FOR REFUND OF PAYMENT ON A WRITTEN CONTRACT. COURT FOUND IN FAVOR OF DEFENDNAT IN SEPARATE CASE CSM-20-862496 AND AWARDED $4,350 TO MR. OBEL. MR. FULLER CLAIMS MR. OBEL KEPT LADDERS BELONGING TO MR. FULLER; PLAINTIFF DENIES SUCH CLAIMS. THE COURT FINDS NO EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT THAT CLAIM OR OTHER CLAIMS BY MR. FULLER. *SEE ATTACHED STATEMENT* STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
